decisive_items: The skin of the forehead, neck, shoulders, and anterior chest had a diffusely rippled appearance
Hale's colloidal iron staining: showed deep dermal mucin
he became increasingly drowsy and weak until he was unable to walk independently
response.rationale: R5 is strongly supported by the rippled skin appearance, deep dermal mucin on Hale's colloidal iron staining, and progressive neurologic deterioration consistent with scleromyxedema/dermato-neuro syndrome. Other candidates lack this combination of mucin deposition and characteristic skin pattern.

rejected.why: Tumorous swellings and purpuric infarcts are nonspecific; no mucin or rippled skin pattern.
Granulomatous inflammation and histiocytes are not specific; lacks mucin deposition and rippled skin.
No cartilage involvement or other relapsing polychondritis features; periorbital swelling is nonspecific.
Histiocytes and tumorous swellings are insufficient; lacks mucin and rippled skin.
Periorbital infiltration and purpuric infarcts are nonspecific; no mucin or rippled skin.
